name: response
label: Response
description: OpenAI Responses API (POST/GET/DELETE /v1/responses). Supports server-side conversation state via previous_response_id or named conversations — multi-turn context preserved without the client tracking history.

responseId.description: Stored response ID (e.g. resp_abc123). Used by get and delete.

model.description: Model name (typically the Hermes profile name)

input.description: Input prompt (string or JSON array of typed input items for multimodal input)

instructions.description: System-level instructions layered on top of Hermes' core system prompt

previous_response_id.description: Chain to a prior stored response. Server reconstructs the full conversation including tool calls and results.

conversation.description: Named conversation. Server automatically chains to the latest response in this conversation, so you don't need to track response IDs.

store.description: Persist this response so it can be used as previous_response_id later (up to 100 stored, LRU eviction).

stream.description: Stream Server-Sent Events. n8n collects all events and returns the final output plus raw events.
